conversations.title: Finding My Bed
conversations.description: Locate your bed and understand the basic setup.

messages.text: Benvenuto! Cerchi il tuo letto?
messages.english: Welcome! Are you looking for your bed?

choices.english: Yes, I am in room four.
No, I am looking for the kitchen now.
Yes, the bathroom is clean.

messages.text: La camera quattro è in fondo al corridoio. Il tuo letto è il numero dodici.
messages.english: Room four is at the end of the corridor. Your bed is number twelve.

choices.english: Is it a bunk bed?
Where is the broken elevator?
The number is too big.

messages.text: Sì, è un letto a castello. Tu sei sotto.
messages.english: Yes, it is a bunk bed. You are on the bottom.

choices.english: Great, I prefer being on the bottom.
No, I want to sleep outside.
Yes, the ceiling is high.

messages.text: Bene. Hai bisogno delle lenzuola?
messages.english: Good. Do you need sheets?

choices.english: No, are they already on the bed?
Yes, I want a blue towel.
No, I have eaten enough.

messages.text: Sì, sono già pronte. Vedi l'armadietto?
messages.english: Yes, they are already ready. Do you see the locker?

choices.english: Yes, is it under the bed?
No, I only see the door.
Yes, the window is open.

messages.text: Esatto, è proprio lì sotto. Hai un lucchetto?
messages.english: Exactly, it is right there underneath. Do you have a padlock?

choices.english: No, I don't have a padlock.

choices.text: Sì, ho la chiave di casa.
choices.english: Yes, I have my house key.
No, the locker is full.

messages.text: Puoi prenderne uno in reception. Costa poco.
messages.english: You can get one at reception. It costs little.

choices.text: Va bene, vado subito a chiedere.
choices.english: All right, I'll go ask immediately.
No, I want to stay here.
Yes, the reception is closed.

messages.text: Perfetto. Hai altre domande sulla camera?
messages.english: Perfect. Do you have other questions about the room?

choices.english: Where are the power outlets?
Where is the bus stop?
What is the name of the hotel?

messages.text: Sono vicino a ogni letto. Le vedi?
messages.english: They are near every bed. Do you see them?

choices.text: Ah sì, le vedo ora. Grazie.
choices.english: Ah yes, I see them now. Thanks.
No, I am too tired.
Yes, the wall is white.

messages.text: Prego! Goditi il soggiorno.
messages.english: You're welcome! Enjoy your stay.

choices.english: Thanks a lot, see you later!
Good morning, how is it going?
No, I am not ready.

conversations.title: Locker Issues
conversations.description: Deal with a locker problem and buy a padlock.

messages.text: Tutto bene con l'armadietto?
messages.english: Everything okay with the locker?

choices.english: No, I can't open it.
Yes, it is very big.
No, the bed is comfortable.

messages.text: Hai provato a usare la tua chiave?
messages.english: Did you try to use your key?

choices.text: Non ho una chiave, serve un lucchetto?
choices.english: I don't have a key, do I need a padlock?
Yes, the key is broken.
No, I am looking for my backpack.

messages.text: Sì, serve un lucchetto personale per chiuderlo.
messages.english: Yes, you need a personal padlock to close it.

choices.english: Can I buy one here?
Where is the supermarket?
The padlock is too small.

messages.text: Sì, alla reception vendiamo lucchetti.
messages.english: Yes, at the reception we sell padlocks.

choices.english: How much does a padlock cost?

choices.text: Qual è il numero di telefono?
choices.english: What is the phone number?
I want to sell my bag.

messages.text: Costa cinque euro. Vuoi prenderlo?
messages.english: It costs five euros. Do you want to take it?

choices.text: Sì, lo prendo. Posso pagare con carta?
choices.english: Yes, I'll take it. Can I pay by card?

choices.text: No, è troppo caro per me.
choices.english: No, it is too expensive for me.
Yes, I ate the apple.

messages.text: Certamente, accettiamo tutte le carte.
messages.english: Certainly, we accept all cards.

choices.english: Perfect. Do I need to show a document?

choices.text: No, non ho la carta ora.
choices.english: No, I don't have the card now.
Yes, the document is old.

messages.text: Sì, serve il tuo passaporto o la carta d'identità.
messages.english: Yes, you need your passport or identity card.

choices.text: Ho il mio passaporto nello zaino.
choices.english: I have my passport in my backpack.
I am going to take the bus.

messages.text: Va bene. Ti aspetto qui alla reception.
messages.english: All right. I'll wait for you here at the reception.

choices.english: I'm coming right away, I'll get everything.

messages.text: Fai con calma. Non c'è fretta.
messages.english: Take your time. There is no rush.

choices.english: Thanks, you are very kind.

messages.text: Figurati! Ci vediamo tra poco.
messages.english: Don't mention it! See you in a bit.

choices.english: See you in a bit, thanks again!
Good morning, how are you?
The bathroom is occupied.

conversations.title: Quiet Hours
conversations.description: Learn about hostel rules regarding noise.

messages.text: Scusami, è mezzanotte passata.
messages.english: Excuse me, it's past midnight.

choices.text: Oh, mi scusi. Sto facendo rumore?
choices.english: Oh, I'm sorry. Am I making noise?

choices.text: Sì, cerco la mia chiave per entrare.
choices.english: Yes, I am looking for my key to enter.

choices.text: No, non ho molta fame a quest'ora.
choices.english: No, I am not very hungry at this hour.

messages.text: Sì, un po'. Dobbiamo rispettare l'orario del silenzio.
messages.english: Yes, a bit. We must respect the quiet hours.

choices.text: A che ora inizia il silenzio?
choices.english: What time do the quiet hours start?
Where are my friends?

messages.text: Inizia alle undici di sera.
messages.english: It starts at eleven in the evening.

choices.text: Non lo sapevo, mi dispiace molto.
choices.english: I didn't know, I am very sorry.

messages.text: Non preoccuparti, ma molti ospiti dormono già.
messages.english: Don't worry, but many guests are already sleeping.

choices.english: Of course, I'll be quiet from now on.

messages.text: Grazie della collaborazione. Hai bisogno di qualcosa?
messages.english: Thanks for your cooperation. Do you need anything?

choices.english: Can I use my cell phone?
Where is the open kitchen?

messages.text: Sì, ma usa le cuffie per favore.
messages.english: Yes, but use headphones please.

choices.text: Sì, ho le mie cuffie qui.
choices.english: Yes, I have my headphones here.
No, I don't have the charger.

messages.text: Perfetto, così non disturbi nessuno.
messages.english: Perfect, that way you don't disturb anyone.

choices.english: Thanks for the advice. Goodnight.

messages.text: Buonanotte a te. Riposa bene.
messages.english: Goodnight to you. Rest well.

choices.english: Thanks, same to you.

messages.text: A domani mattina per la colazione.
messages.english: See you tomorrow morning for breakfast.

choices.text: A che ora è la colazione?
choices.english: What time is breakfast?

choices.text: No, non mi piace il latte.

messages.text: Dalle otto alle dieci. A domani!
messages.english: From eight to ten. See you tomorrow!

choices.english: Perfect, see you tomorrow! Goodnight.
Good morning, what time is it?
The coffee is cold.

conversations.title: Common Room Intro
conversations.description: Discover the shared spaces and kitchen rules.

messages.text: Ciao! Questa è la nostra sala comune.
messages.english: Hi! This is our common room.

choices.text: È molto bella! Posso mangiare qui?
choices.english: It's very nice! Can I eat here?
No, I want to go home.
Yes, the bathroom is small.

messages.text: Certo, ma per favore pulisci il tavolo dopo.
messages.english: Sure, but please clean the table afterwards.

choices.text: Va bene. Dove si trova la cucina?
choices.english: All right. Where is the kitchen?
No, I don't want to clean anything.
The table is made of wood.

messages.text: La cucina è nella porta accanto, a sinistra.
messages.english: The kitchen is in the next door, on the left.

choices.text: C'è un frigorifero per il mio cibo?
choices.english: Is there a fridge for my food?
Where is the emergency exit?

messages.text: Sì, ma metti sempre un'etichetta col tuo nome.
messages.english: Yes, but always put a label with your name.

choices.english: Do you have labels here?

choices.text: No, il mio nome è segreto.
choices.english: No, my name is secret.

messages.text: Sì, sono sulla porta del frigorifero.
messages.english: Yes, they are on the fridge door.

choices.text: Ottimo. Il wifi funziona anche qui?
choices.english: Great. Does the wifi work here too?

messages.text: Sì, il wifi è veloce in tutta la sala.
messages.english: Yes, the wifi is fast in the whole room.

choices.text: Qual è la password della rete?
choices.english: What is the network password?
Where is the TV remote?

messages.text: La trovi scritta sulla lavagna lì.
messages.english: You find it written on the blackboard there.

choices.english: Ah, I see it now. Thanks.

messages.text: Puoi anche usare il computer laggiù.
messages.english: You can also use the computer over there.

choices.english: Is it free for guests?
How much does the computer cost?

messages.text: Sì, è gratuito per trenta minuti.
messages.english: Yes, it is free for thirty minutes.

choices.text: Perfetto, mi serve solo per poco.
choices.english: Perfect, I only need it for a bit.

messages.text: Divertiti e conosci gli altri ragazzi!
messages.english: Have fun and meet the other guys!

choices.english: Definitely! Thanks a lot for the help.
No, I am very shy.
Hi, my name is Marco.
